title: Dispersive estimates for wave-type equations with time-dependent damping
summary: In this paper, we study the Cauchy problem for a class of semilinear evolution equations with scale-invariant time-dependent dissipation \begin{equation*} \begin{cases} u_{tt} + L_{w^2}u + \dfracμ{1+t}u_t = Δ^θ f(u), & t>0,\ x\in\mathbb{R}^n,\\ u(0,x) = 0,\qquad u_t(0,x) = u_1(x), & x\in\mathbb{R}^n, \end{cases} \end{equation*} where $μ>0$, $f(u)=|u|^α$ with $α>1$, $θ\in\{0,1\}$, and the operator $L_{w^2}$ is defined on the Fourier transform by multiplication by $w(ξ)^2$.
